StackPerch（原名 KeepAny）是独立开发者的本地数字资产工作台。把项目、域名、账号、订阅和维护事项连起来，找到下一步该处理的事。旧 KeepAny GitHub 链接仍转到 StackPerch。

StackPerch, formerly KeepAny, is a local digital asset workspace for independent developers. Find the accounts, domains, subscriptions, and maintenance behind each project. Older KeepAny GitHub links still redirect to StackPerch.
